manifest.description: Authenticated playback for multiple independent Mashin clients.

max_registered_devices.label: Maximum registered devices
max_registered_devices.description: Provider-wide admission limit for new device identities. Existing devices can reconnect even above this limit.

max_devices_per_user.label: Maximum devices per user
max_devices_per_user.description: Admission limit for new device identities belonging to one MA user. Existing ownership records are preserved.

max_websocket_connections.label: Maximum WebSocket connections
max_websocket_connections.description: Provider-wide limit including Control, Audio and handshakes. Allow room for reconnecting clients.

tls_proxy_ip.label: Trusted TLS proxy IP
tls_proxy_ip.description: Optional exact socket IP of a trusted TLS reverse proxy. Only this peer may attest HTTPS via X-Forwarded-Proto.
